A register of a product gap, asserted by its spec so the number cannot quietly grow; nothing consumes it because nothing yet acts on the gap

the internal keys `publishedNameFor` returns null for, with a reason each. Read by its own spec, checked both ways so a key that gains a mapping must leave the list. Nothing else consumes it because the null on the wire is the whole message to a client -- the reason is for whoever has to fix it. 'Sanitary/Plumbing' is now resolved on the evidence: the bundled forms are NBC A-05 (Sanitary, Code on Sanitation) and NBC A-06 (Plumbing, Revised Plumbing Code), so they are two permits nationally and the key is a stale combined name

src/modules/identity/domain/staff-access: the domain statement of what a level means. Production enforces it in scopesFor(), which withholds every authority-granting scope from a 'view' token — so the rule is applied at the one point a token's scopes are decided rather than re-asked per call site. Kept because it is where the rule is written down and tested against every role

the domain statement of the forms allow-list. Production asks the same question in SQL — the read path ANDs it into the query so an officer cannot infer the COUNT of applications outside their forms, and the write path checks one indexed row inside the transaction. Both are optimisations of this predicate, and this is where the semantics (empty means none, matching is exact) are stated and tested
